summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate (Rochester Institute of Technology) with embedded firmware development (C) experience across STM32, Jetson, and Arduino platforms. Built bare-metal microcontroller firmware with interrupt-driven peripheral control, FreeRTOS task scheduling, and UART/I2C communication, validating designs through bench testing and Proteus simulation. Resolved 11 integration failures across a distributed embedded system through systematic debugging and authored full engineering documentation for hardware deliverables.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; authored full claims documentation and BOM for hardware deliverables.
Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; performed debugging and bench testing to resolve sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used Git for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 embedded firmware development (C) for real-time temperature monitoring with timer-synchronized sensing and display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver; programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1).

Achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; supported test tools development in Proteus circuit simulation for product testing and debugging / bench testing of the design.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on STM32 microcontroller firmware receiving interrupt-driven UART commands from a Jetson-based vision pipeline.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART command handling and user override; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) across a distributed Jetson+Arduino embedded control system through systematic debugging / bench testing and code reviews; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++, driving five servos with range-gated contact detection via dual ToF sensors.
Deployed Jetson-side embedded firmware as a systemd service with auto-restart, non-root isolation, and static IP networking for reliable multi-device communication.
